title: feat(nsopplaqt): nsopp plaquette own-tick holonomy: reverse fails, face fails
science: Own-tick variant of the plaquette holonomy: each vertex's letter is read at its own formation tick instead of at a common deadline. H is again UNDEFINED for the same reason (two non-unique corners), and reverse moves UNDEFINED -> fails only because unrecorded (MISSING) becomes recorded-but-non-unique (NONUNIQUE). Confirms the holonomy obstruction is a property of the perp-step rule, not of the read deadline.
